bundlingNotes: Wisconsin's calculator is structurally more complex than any other state's tool encountered this session: since 2015-10-03 (per the tool's own on-page disclaimer) Knight Barry's WI calculator has separately shown (a) the rate lenders must disclose on the federal Loan Estimate/Closing Disclosure forms (which uses full owner's-policy rates plus the simultaneous-loan discount rate, producing a HIGHER loan-policy figure than the actual charge) versus (b) the 'Actual Charges to All Parties' actually collected at closing, further split into 3 sub-options (A/B/C) depending on whether buyer or seller contractually pays for the owner's policy. Recorded here are the LE-disclosure figures (the consumer-facing regulatory disclosure) and the Option C actual-charge figures for comparison; this LE-vs-actual gap is itself a notable WI-specific regulatory finding worth flagging in any future settlement-fee analysis. First WI calculator-basis provider found this session (below the 3-provider threshold).
transactionContext: Calculator-derived point estimate for the standard $500k/$400k Milwaukee County purchase scenario, buyer side.
